name: Sniffington
description: Monitors brand mentions across Reddit, X, LinkedIn and other platforms. Exposes mentions, briefs, analytics and reply drafting via an OAuth-gated MCP server, a REST API and an npm CLI.

skills.name: Mention Monitoring
skills.description: List, filter, bulk-update and export brand mentions and pull a periodic brief via list_mentions, export_mentions and get_brief.

skills.name: Reply Drafting
skills.description: Generate reply drafts for a mention, a Reddit comment or an outreach message with draft_reply, draft_reddit_comment and draft_outreach.

skills.name: Reddit Opportunities
skills.description: Find subreddits and threads worth joining using find_reddit_opportunities, plan_reddit_post and build_reddit_strategy.

skills.name: Competitor Share of Voice
skills.description: Track rivals and compute share of voice with list_competitors, competitor_brief, export_rival_card and get_share_of_voice.

skills.name: Mention Analytics
skills.description: Query volume, breakdowns and overviews, including read-only SQL over workspace data, via get_analytics, get_volume and query_sql.

skills.name: Human Review Queue
skills.description: Pull posts awaiting a human verdict with list_review_queue and record rulings through update_mention or update_account_post.

skills.name: Alerts and Webhooks
skills.description: Create alerts and webhook subscriptions, then test them, rotate secrets and replay deliveries with test_webhook and replay_webhook_delivery.
